name: Drawer
description: Right-side desktop drawer with a responsive mobile bottom sheet, sharing Sheet modal and focus behavior.

figma.notes: Based on the cart observed on 2026-10-13. No independent Figma binding assigned.

size.description: Mobile bottom-sheet height; desktop is always full height.

contentPadding.description: Spacing of the independently scrolling body.

footer.description: Host-owned actions outside the scrolling content.

back.description: Child view navigation; Escape returns to the parent.

focus.note: Uses shared focus aliases and native keyboard behavior.

radius.note: Semantic radii; a desktop edge-attached Drawer has square corners.

testing.rationale: Storybook play tests cover controlled changes, keyboard and validation; browser tests cover responsive geometry.
